According to the question stem, the question asks “what does internal force action mainly affect in a river.” Riverbank erosion, sediment deposition, and so on mainly belong to external force action; internal force action mainly changes the height differences and slope direction of regional terrain through crustal movement and so on. Rivers are always controlled by the slope direction of the terrain, flowing from high places to low places; therefore, internal force action mainly affects the flow direction of rivers.
